newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Aug 19.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories Tuesday.
* The Dow Industrials surged more than 100 points on Monday, cutting losses from Friday.
* The FCC is expected to reject Ameritech's bid to offer long-distance service in its region.
* Texaco agreed to buy Monterey Resources.
* Hewlett-Packard shares fell on lower-than-expected earnings.
* Dow Chemical was found by a jury to have knowingly deceived women about the health risks of silicone breast implants.
* Mexico's economy showed its highest quarterly jump in 16 years.
* Bad publicity on Nazi-Era dealings has not hurt Swiss banks.
* Treasuries gained Monday amid stock market volatility.
* The Teamsters union and the United Farm Workers are aiming to protect the low-wage workers who pick apples in Washington state.
* The Utne Reader hired Veronis Suhler to help it find an investor or a buyer.
* Macy's is expanding its line of merchandise to include eye glasses and contact lenses.
